name: Abyssal Lapidary
summary: Abyssal Lapidary has no AI disclosure visible on the checked full-game Steam page. Players have raised AI-related allegations, but the reviewed sources do not substantiate them as official production facts.
steamReleaseDate: Coming soon（计划；核查时尚未发售）

sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: 完整商店页未显示 AI 生成内容披露栏；未披露不等于未使用。

sources.label: Steam 讨论区首页核查
sources.excerpt: 英文讨论区首页显示 15 个主题（总数 160）；仅覆盖首页。

sources.label: Undisclosed AI usage : I'm blacklisting even though I enjoyed
sources.excerpt: Players allege coding-related AI use and discuss other assets. The visible replies do not provide a verified original developer statement. These remain community allegations; only the visible first page of replies was read.

sources.label: Public reporting / reference
sources.excerpt: A fan reference page summarizes unconfirmed art, coding and translation allegations, while explicitly declining to verify them. It is not an official developer source.

reviewNote: Checked the full-game Steam identity and complete store page, the English discussion homepage and any related visible first-page threads, plus a separate per-game web search. This is not a full historical or multilingual audit. Search limitations and source scope are recorded with the evidence. No disclosure does not mean no AI use. A search-indexed historical disclosure claim could not be verified: its original index URL returned HTTP 410. No historical disclosure is adopted from that snippet. The visible community thread contains allegations rather than a verified original developer production statement.
